lines.text: The LORD tells Aaron to bring the Levites from his father's tribe to assist him, but they must not touch the altar.
The LORD gives the Levites to Aaron as a gift, and only Aaron and his sons serve as priests inside the veil.
The LORD gives Aaron's family the offerings, and a month-old firstborn son is redeemed for ten shekels of silver.
The LORD tells Aaron he has no land inheritance, and the Levites receive all the firstfruits in Israel as their inheritance.
The LORD tells Moses that the Levites must present a tithe of the tithe, giving the best part to Aaron the priest.
